offering_description.value: Operates outpatient diagnostic imaging centers and sells AI-enabled radiology software. Imaging is performed at its own centers for patients referred by physicians and health systems, and software is licensed to hospitals and radiology practices.

primary_products.value: AI breast cancer detection software; radiology workflow software

primary_services.value: MRI scans; CT scans; mammography; PET imaging; ultrasound

customer_segment.value: B2B: referring physicians, hospitals, health systems, radiology practices, insurers; B2C: patients receiving imaging exams, including self-pay patients

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: payments from insurers and Medicare for imaging exams; subscription: AI software licensed to hospitals and radiology groups

value_chain_position.value: service provider: operates imaging centers and sells exams to patients and referring physicians; software / platform: develops AI radiology software sold to healthcare providers

geography_served.value: US national: imaging centers in several states including California, New York, New Jersey, Florida and Texas

specialization.value: related lines: outpatient imaging services and radiology AI software

distribution_channels.value: own locations: owned outpatient imaging centers; direct sales: software sold directly to hospitals and radiology groups; other: patient referrals from physicians and health systems

regulatory_exposure.value: high: imaging centers need state licenses and Medicare certification, AI software needs FDA clearance
